about: The M5 ablation sweep. Identifiers and counts only. Rendered as results/necessity-matrix.md. Tiering rule and materiality threshold: docs/methodology.md Sections 3 and 4. Rulings: ablation/rulings.py.

tested: the class's detector reads this field, and nulling it had no measurable effect
cell_codes.X: the class becomes undetectable: detection falls to 0/n
cell_codes.ab: absent: no detector and no delivered attack
cell_codes.nr: not read: the class's detector does not read this field, so nulling it could not move the result
cell_codes.nt: not testable: the class has no successful trials, so there is no detection rate to move
cell_codes.x: detection degrades materially, with nothing going dark
